enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Shift position. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Pick up clothes. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast while reviewing the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Pick up phone. Open calendar app. Review schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional on clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take notes on computer. Talk to nurse. Administer medication. Update patient records. Attend meeting. Review lab results. Consult with doctor.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Check phone. Talk to colleague. Throw away trash. Return tray.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and patient care at work
enriched_activities.desc: Wash hands. Enter patient room. Check patient. Administer treatment. Talk to patient. Update records. Consult with doctor. Attend to emergency. Assist colleague. Review test results. Write prescriptions. Clean equipment.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pot. Fill with water. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up bowl. Pour soup into bowl. Sit at table. Eat soup. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up and doing light household chores with the vacuum cleaner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put away vacuum. Wipe table with cloth. Arrange pillows. Throw away trash.
Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly before bed under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Adjust pillow.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Shift position. Continue sleeping.
